text: Managing a team effectively requires a blend of soft skills. Firstly, clear communication is essential; ensure everyone understands their tasks and the team's goals. Delegation involves sharing responsibilities based on strengths, not just dumping work. Regular feedback, both positive and constructive, helps team members grow and feel valued. To maintain motivation, recognise achievements and create a supportive atmosphere where people feel heard. When conflicts arise, address them quickly by listening to each side and finding a fair solution. These practices build trust, boost productivity, and keep the team focused on success.
